description: This file defines data structures and functions for generating health check reports of system components such as nodes, pods, connectivity, and metrics. It includes a dataclass 'HealthResult' and utility functions to assess system readiness and compile a report.

classes.name: HealthResult
classes.description: Dataclass representing the structured health report, including fields like site_id, environment, timestamp, nodes, pods, connectivity, metrics, status, and summary.

methods.name: bool _all_nodes_ready(nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Checks whether all nodes in the list are marked as ready.

methods.name: bool _all_pods_running(pods: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Checks whether all pods are in the 'RUNNING' phase.

methods.name: str _derive_status(node_ready: bool, pods_running: bool, anomalies: List[Dict[str, Any]], connectivity: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Determines the overall health status ('healthy' or 'degraded') based on node readiness, pod states, anomalies, and connectivity.

methods.name: HealthResult build_health_report( site_id: Optional[str], environment: str, nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]], pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], connectivity: Dict[str, Any], metrics: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Main function to assemble and return a 'HealthResult' object encapsulating the current health status given the system components' data.

ctags.name: _derive_status
ctags.pattern: /^def _derive_status(node_ready: bool, pods_running: bool, anomalies: List[Dict[str, Any]], connec/
ctags.signature: (node_ready: bool, pods_running: bool, anomalies: List[Dict[str, Any]], connectivity: Dict[str, Any])

ctags.name: build_health_report
ctags.signature: ( site_id: Optional[str], environment: str, nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]], pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], connectivity: Dict[str, Any], metrics: Dict[str, Any], )
